summary: Flat east kerb mid-street, homes about 16 m on both sides.
reasons: Homes 16 m or more each side
Cars park along the west kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes about 16 m away on the east side and homes across the road on the west; no bush backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on the west kerb; the east verge is grassed and treed with room to stop.
drivers.convention: Residents park on this street; a van would blend in but not unnoticed overnight.

flags: Dwellings 14-16 m away on both sides
Most of the stretch is steep (mean 6.5%, max 15.6%) with houses 4-8 m from the kerb
Mapped gates 242 m or more away have ways round
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover on the east verge gives afternoon shade; open to the morning sun on the west.

best_section.where: Castile Street east kerb at the flat low point, between the two pool houses
